item.title: Is South Korean Capital the Missing Ingredient in America’s Nuclear Comeback?
item.description: America wants a nuclear renaissance. It may yet need a South Korean one. item.title: The US Navy Is Overhauling Its Physical Training Uniforms
item.description: A common complaint about the existing PT uniforms is that they do not fit well—and are made of absorbent materials that do not “wick” moisture like civilian running clothes. item.title: Donald Trump Risks a Quagmire in Iran
item.description: The Trump administration appears to believe that the Iranian government can be overthrown, or at least coerced into a political settlement, via airstrikes. History begs to differ. The post Donald Trump Risks a Quagmire in Iran appeared first on The National Interest.

item.title: Why Estonia Is Pouring Landmines onto Its Border with Russia
item.description: Estonia, Latvia, and Lithuania are cooperating in a joint effort to fortify their shared border with Russia—including through mines, anti-tank fortifications, and new bunker construction.
